thread:
inc-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 429s from rate-limiter in prod - service=redwood-api, region=us-west-2, started=2026-03-15T02:15:00Z

oncall-sara: seeing it on Grafana too. 429s up ~7x for generate/embeddings routes. paging michael now.

michael: on my way. ops runbook open: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rlv2

deploy-bot: Deploy event: canary rollout "rlv2-2026-03-15" by @alex finished at 2026-03-15T02:12Z. Canary targets: 5% of traffic.

alex: I rolled the exemption patch that moved exemption predicates into the new policy path (PR #2543). I saw local tests pass.

oncall-sara: timeline suggests correlation. can we confirm exemptions are being applied? quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM rate_events WHERE exempt=true AND ts > now()-5m;`

michael: running checks.

kevin: adding logs filter: `service=rate-limiter level=info msg="exempt"` - attaching first 50 lines below:
```
2026-03-15T02:13:05Z service=rate-limiter msg="exempt eval" user_id=acct_123 rule=quota-exempt reason=legacy
2026-03-15T02:13:07Z service=rate-limiter msg="exempt eval" user_id=acct_456 rule=quota-exempt reason=legacy
2026-03-15T02:13:09Z service=rate-limiter msg="exempt eval" user_id=acct_789 rule=quota-exempt reason=legacy
```

kevin: ...and then after 02:14:30 the logs show new evals coming from `policy=v2` with no `exempt` messages.

michael: hypothesis: new policy path doesn't map old exemption keys -> missing exemptions -> customers hit 429s. That would explain sudden increase.

alex: ack. I did rename the predicate keys to `customer.exempt` in PR, maybe we forgot the compatibility shim.

oncall-sara: impact? which customers affected? any Dedicated/reserved accounts?

customer-ops-bot: 3 paying customers showing elevated 429s: AcmeAI (high), BrightDocs (med), BetaShop (low). AcmeAI error rate 18% on embeddings since 02:15.

tara: alerting AcmeAI PM + AE, giving initial note: "We're investigating increased rate limit responses for some requests; a potential rollback is in progress. Will update in 15 minutes."

michael: recommend kill-switch -> flip `rlv2.enable=true` to false to force old path. Can we flip at infra feature-flag?

alex: I can flip, but that will revert unrelated harmless changes in the canary. I think it's acceptable.

oncall-sara: do it. publish rollback reason in incident channel once flipped.

alex: flipping flag now: `./flagctl set rlv2.enable false --env=prod --target=canary`

deploy-bot: Feature-flag change recorded: rlv2.enable=false by alex at 2026-03-15T02:20:10Z (scope: canary).

michael: metrics check: 429 rate dropping at 02:21:12Z, AcmeAI rate down to 3%. Looks promising.

kevin: confirming tokens accounting: there is a backlog of decremented tokens for some sessions (counter drift). Running compensator job `token-reconcile --since=2026-03-15T02:00Z`.

oncall-sara: what's the plan to avoid recurrence?

michael: short term: revert the predicate rename in policy v2 (hotfix PR) + add a compatibility layer that maps old keys to `customer.exempt`. Longer term: add deploy-time integration tests that run a smoke canary against exempted account list.

alex: opened hotfix PR #2551, CI green. request review from eng-platform.

tara: customer comms: send an update in 30m with root cause = canary policy change removed legacy exemption mapping; mitigation = flag flip and hotfix; next steps = full rollback of the policy change if hotfix not merged within 2 hours.

michael: handing to kevin for post-action verification and runbook update. oncall rotation note: @oncall-sara handing off to @michael at 02:25 UTC for watch.

oncall-sara: thanks, logging incident in pagerduty and setting severity=sev2. PD incident: PD-13254.

customer-ops-bot: AcmeAI notified at 02:27 UTC. AE assigned: lena.

kevin: compensator job completed at 02:32:18Z - reconciled token counters for 98% of affected sessions. Leftover items smaller than threshold, will be processed by nightly job.

michael: OK, monitors stabilized. set to mitigated. Please keep on-call for 1 hour and watch for regression.

alex: I'll cut the hotfix deploy to canary now, patch has the compatibility shim. `kubectl apply -f hotfix-v2551.yaml`

deploy-bot: Rollout started: hotfix-v2551 to canary. cadence=gradual (5% -> 25% -> 100%).

michael: confirm no new 429 spike during canary expansion at 02:46. proceeding to 25%.

kevin: after 03:01, metrics show exemption evals present in policy=v2 path. logs sample:
```
2026-03-15T02:58:12Z service=rate-limiter msg="exempt eval" user_id=acct_123 rule=quota-exempt reason=legacy mapped=true
2026-03-15T02:58:13Z service=rate-limiter msg="exempt eval" user_id=acct_456 rule=quota-exempt reason=legacy mapped=true
```

michael: expanding to 100% at 03:05 after 20m stable canary.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: hotfix-v2551 at 03:08:02Z.

oncall-sara: incident status -> mitigated. creating postmortem ticket (PM-1849). Please add timeline and action items.

tara: customer follow-up scheduled in 1h and 24h.

alex: retrospective action items: 1) add pre-merge canary smoke for exemption cases, 2) add automated diff check for policy key renames, 3) feature-flag review checklist.

michael: closing watch in 30m if no regressions. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

oncall-sara: +1. filing severity/impact: sev2, 3 customers impacted (1 high), estimated MTTD 3m, MTTR 53m.

customer-ops-bot: closing customer incident threads pending confirmation from AcmeAI.

michael: postmortem draft assigned to alex, due EOD.

kevin: adding metrics graphs and the compensator job logs to the PM.
notes: Make sure to redact any customer PII before publishing the postmortem.
